classification.difficultyReason: Determine the rectangle's length from its width, then add all four side lengths.

content.prompt:
The width of a rectangle is $6.7\text{ cm}$. Its length is $4.6\text{ cm}$ longer than its width.
Find the perimeter of the rectangle. (Hint: draw a diagram!)

spec.description: Authored solution sketch of the rectangle with its calculated length and given width.
